info.t: Before you start: the experience boosters
b: Rest is the biggest boost you have. Log out in an inn or a capital city and rested experience builds up: your kills then give double experience until it runs out.
Eat cooked food before a long stretch of fighting (Well Fed: +5% experience from kills), and sleep on a Cozy Sleeping Bag for up to +3% more.
If you will play more than one character, the Legacy perks pay back first: Well Rested (more rest), Talented (talent points five levels early) and Frequent Flier (quicker flights).

info.t: Dungeons: once each, with their quests
b: Forever pays most of a dungeon’s experience through its quests, and most of that on the first run. Since Blizzard’s hotfixes of November 9 every kill inside pays 50% more, and since those of November 13 a kill pays no one when the enemy is trivial to anyone in the group, so a high-level friend can no longer pull you through for experience. Take all of its quests before you go in, run it once, then carry on questing. The dungeons in this route are all optional, and a group makes them easy; skip any you cannot fill.

A character that reaches level 25 earns your account’s first Legacy point and opens the perk trees. If you will make more characters, Well Rested is the usual first pick; the Legacy planner has Grimoire’s four perk builds.

Apprentice Riding opens at level 40, and a mount comes with it: about a hundred gold for +60% speed on the ground. Keep the money from the 30s. Skyborne buy theirs at the Fairweather Stables on Zephras Isle; everyone else at their riding trainer.

From the mid 50s Classic’s quests are mostly elite and dungeon work, so this route has you kill your way through part of these levels. Group up if you can: Stratholme, Scholomance, Blackrock Depths and Spire, Dire Maul and Forever’s Blackmaw Hold and Shaper’s Terrace all pay well through their quests, and a first run’s turn-ins matter more than its kills. Blizzard says Shaper’s Terrace uses power crystals from Un’Goro at consoles inside, so collect some on the way.

Forever adds ships these routes do not use: Stormwind Harbor to Auberdine, and a stop at Hillsbrad (Southshore) on the Menethil to Auberdine line. QuestieDB places dock workers at Stormwind Harbor, but no one it traces can be tied to a new dock in Auberdine or Southshore, and no open data gives the crossing times. If one saves you a walk, such as the run through Dun Algaz to the Wetlands, take it and rejoin the route where it fits.

info.t: Riverglades, a Forever zone for 38 to 44
b: Riverglades is new: the east coast of the Eastern Kingdoms, between Redridge Mountains, the Burning Steppes and the Swamp of Sorrows, with the dungeon Krol’dok Stronghold, entered through a cave on a hill north of Sunnyglade. Alliance quests start at Farhold Keep, the Horde’s at Rog’mar. You get there by the road north of Redridge, or by the ship from Tanaris to Powderfuse Port.

QuestieDB has 172 of its quests, most of them for levels 38 to 44. Its steps follow the places QuestieDB traced on the zone’s own map; their distances and minutes are estimates, because no open data gives the size of that map. Of the 99 quests here at 36 to 45 that the Alliance can take, each route takes 41 to 44. 55 are on none: 2 because QuestieDB’s traces give no giver, 26 no place for an objective, 19 because they follow one of those, and the routes pass over the other 8.

info.t: Shen’dralas, a Forever zone for 40 to 43
b: Shen’dralas lies in central Kalimdor between Mulgore, Desolace and Feralas; the Valley of Bones quests of southern Desolace send you there. QuestieDB has 35 of its quests, most of them for levels 40 to 43: its story continues the centaur quests of Desolace and sends you on into Maraudon and Razorfen Downs. The way in is the Gelkis’s: Uthek the Wise in Gelkis Village gives Valley of Bones once you are Friendly with her clan (about 50 Magram centaurs killed by Classic’s numbers; each kill costs you standing with the Magram) and have done Stealing Supplies and Ongeku for her. This route goes that way. Its steps follow the places QuestieDB traced on the zone’s own map; their distances and minutes are estimates, because no open data gives the size of that map.

Mount Hyjal is Forever’s endgame zone, on the slopes of the World Tree above Winterspring and Felwood, with Hyjal Summit (20 players) and Barrow Deeps (10); the raids open on December 9. QuestieDB has 145 of its quests, most of them for levels 56 to 60. Its steps follow the places QuestieDB traced on the zone’s own map; their distances and minutes are estimates, because no open data gives the size of that map. Of the 126 quests here at 56 to 60 that the Alliance can take, each route takes 53 to 63. 62 are on none: 1 no turn-in, 20 no place for an objective, 25 because they follow one of those, and the routes pass over the other 16.

Every Skyborne starts on Zephras Isle, a floating island in the plane of Skywall, and plays its story up to level 12 before joining the Horde or the Alliance. QuestieDB has the island’s 149 quests; the steps below take you through them to 12. Its steps follow the places QuestieDB traced on the zone’s own map; their distances and minutes are estimates, because no open data gives the size of that map. At 12 the island sends you on and the route picks up in your faction’s lands.
Your class trainer’s first quests and training still come on the way: see your trainer every couple of levels.
